records.confirmed: Specified hot-work conditions trigger employer duties to establish and communicate reporting arrangements and response procedures including leaving work, cooling and medical care as necessary.
records.scope: The page specifies WBGT >=28 or temperature >=31 Celsius, with anticipated continuous work >=1 hour or daily work >4 hours. These are scope conditions for the stated duties, not an automatic universal shutdown rule.
records.simulation_use: Requires a non-abolished institutional baseline in every arm. No legal temperature or duration is converted into a toy decision threshold.

records.confirmed: An official heat alert information system exists.
records.simulation_use: Motivates separating information from execution. All numerical observation errors are synthetic, not estimates of alert quality.

records.confirmed: The national government changed river policy assumptions for the Mukawa, Saru and Asahi systems to consider increased future rainfall under climate change.
records.simulation_use: Counterevidence to an absent-national-baseline-change premise. This flood policy is not a heat-work intervention and is not a simulation parameter.

provenance_boundary: Manually checked, paraphrased source claims with URLs and access date; not raw-source archival hashes or a complete legal inventory. No private conversation or personal data is an input.
